status: Offline missing-provider/recovery fixture and candidate 15 full RPM build, install and checks pass. OBS source submission awaits the independent lint decision.
root_cause: ca-certificates contains the distribution certificate-store management scripts and recommends ca-certificates-mozilla. OBS omits weak dependencies, leaving the generated bundle without roots. pip cannot load that file into its truststore context and emits the exact missing-certificates warning.
fix: Explicit BuildRequires: ca-certificates-mozilla, preserving the normal verified TLS context and keeping runtime policy unchanged. Normal runtime installs already honor the ca-certificates recommendation; administrators may supply custom roots.
